name: statevector partial trace order
task_prompt:
From the 2-qubit Statevector |10> (qubit 0 in |1>, qubit 1 in |0>), trace out qubit 0 and return the remaining single-qubit DensityMatrix as a numpy array (must be |1>: diag(0,1)).
You must implement this using a function named `trace_out_first` taking no arguments.
